A '''planet''' was located on the edges of the [[Torch Nebula/Legends|Torch Nebula]],<ref name="Codex" /> a [[Nebula/Legends|nebula]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="EAOC" /> A nameless [[Jungle/Legends|jungle]] world, the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] was believed by [[Biologist/Legends|biologists]] serving the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]] to be the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Lurker/Legends|lurker]], an amphibious [[Limb/Legends|bipedal]] [[Species/Legends|creature]] that was first identified in the larger [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]<ref name="Codex" /> at some point by [[3840 BBY]].<ref name="Time">Per the reasoning [[Template:TOR_dates|here]], Act III of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' takes place around [[3640 BBY]]. Since the Codex entry for [[Lurker/Legends|lurkers]] can only be discovered on [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]], which is visited by all classes in Act III, the information contained therein can be dated to 3640 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]]. The Codex entry states that lurkers became known in the wider [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]] two hundred [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the events of the game, which corresponds to [[3840 BBY]].</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The jungle world was first mentioned in the Codex entry for lurkers in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]].<ref name="Codex" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Torch Nebula, and therefore the unnamed planet, within grid square P-19.<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> Following the [[April 25]], [[2014]] discontinuation of the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity,<ref name="End of EU">{{SW|url=news/the-legendary-star-wars-expanded-universe-turns-a-new-page|text=The Legendary Star Wars Expanded Universe Turns a New Page}}</ref> the homeworld of the lurkers was re-introduced into the new ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]] and given the name [[Judakann]] by ''[[Poe Dameron: Free Fall]]'', a [[2020]] novel by [[Alex Segura]].<ref name="Poe">''[[Poe Dameron: Free Fall]]''</ref>
